subject: Renewal & procurement: vendor onboarding refresh + capacity uplift
messages:
From: Claire Morris <claire.morris@pioneerhealth.com>
To: hannah_schmitt@redwood.com, jordan_blake@redwood.com
Cc: procure@pioneerhealth.com
Date: Wed, 17 Sep 2025 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal & capacity increase — procurement onboarding and PO path

Hi Hannah and Jordan,

Hope youre both well. Pioneers annual renewal for Redwood (term ending 11/30/2025) is coming up. Were planning two items as part of the renewal:

- Term extension: +12 months (standard terms)
- Capacity uplift: ~15% additional committed throughput for Q1 (projected need for pilot expansion across two departments)

Procurement asks: we need a short vendor onboarding refresh so our procurement portal shows current W-9, SOC2 attestation link, and the updated SOW/PO path. Can you confirm the preferred SOW to send, and who will upload the evidence into our portal? Our vendor team also needs an updated PO template and a canonical contact for invoice routing.

Attached: Renewal_request_Sept2025.docx (summary of requested changes and a rough volume estimate).

Can we do a quick 30-min sync this week? If you prefer, Jordan, feel free to send the DocuSign link and SOW and Ill route through procurement.

Thanks,
Claire Morris
Sr. Manager, Vendor Programs
Pioneer Health
claire.morris@pioneerhealth.com
(415) 555-0182

Attachments: Renewal_request_Sept2025.docx (docx)

Subject: Re: Renewal & capacity increase — procurement onboarding and PO path

Thanks Claire — appreciate the summary. Short answers below and a proposed next steps list.

Quick notes:
- We can do the 12-month extension and accommodate the +15% committed capacity.
- Ill own the evidence upload into your procurement portal (Markus will verify SOC2 link and W-9).
- Jordan will prepare an updated SOW and the DocuSign envelope for signature.

Proposed next steps (internal + procurement):
1) Jordan: attach SOW_Redwood_v2.pdf and share DocuSign link (target: EOD Thu).
2) Pioneer: send PO number or PO template so we can match the invoice (Tom / procure@).
3) Hannah/Markus: upload updated W-9 + SOC2 pointer to Pioneer portal and confirm vendor ID.
4) Well produce a 1-page MAP (mutual action plan) showing dates for PO, signature, and ramp — attached draft.

Ive attached a draft MAP (MAP_draft.xlsx) for your review. If youd like a quick call Im available tomorrow 10:00–11:30 PT.

Best,
Hannah Schmitt
